title: The Clampetts Strike Oil
overview: When an oil wildcatter discovers a huge pool of oil in Jed Clampetts’ swamp, Jed sells his land to the O.K. Oil Company for $34 million. At the urging of his cousin, Pearl, Jed moves his family to a 35 room mansion in Beverly Hills, California.

title: Getting Settled
overview: When the Clampetts arrive at their new Mansion, they are mistaken by miss Hathaway for a staff of bumbling, insubordinate, backwoods servants.

title: Meanwhile, Back at the Cabin
overview: The Clampetts find that the comforts of the mansion do not always compare to the comforts of their former mountain shack. Meanwhile, Cousin Pearl is back at the cabin making eyes with the visiting oil man.

title: The Clampetts Meet Mrs. Drysdale
overview: When Mr. Drysdale describes Mrs. Drysdale as being a hypochondriac, the Clampets assume she must be a drunk.

title: Jed Buys Stock
overview: Granny prepares her special mash to help cure Mrs. Drysdale of her drinking problem while Jed follows Mr. Drysdale’s suggestion to buy “stock” by buying cows, pigs, and chickens.

title: Trick or Treat
overview: The homesick Clampetts, unaware that it’s Halloween, decide to go calling on their new Beverly Hills neighbors.

title: The Servants
overview: Drysdale attempts another step in social renovation of the Clampetts by lending them his servants.

title: Jethro Goes to School
overview: A private school teacher is shocked to learn that her new 5th-grade student is Jethro.

title: Elly's First Date
overview: Mr. Drysdale convinces his self-absorbed stepson Sonny to date Elly May. Granny and Jed make preparations for Thanksgiving.

title: Pygmalion and Elly
overview: Sonny Drysdale decides he needs to be Pygmalion to Elly’s Galatea and remake her from a hillbilly into a woman of society, while Granny uses love charms to heat up their relationship.

title: Elly Races Jethrine
overview: Granny believes that Sonny Drysdale is going to propose to Elly May and becomes a matchmaker. Cousin Pearl tries to hurry Jethrine’s relationship with Jasper Depew.

title: The Great Feud
overview: Granny and the rest of the Clampetts start a feud with the Drysdales after Sonny breaks up with Elly May instead of marrying her.

title: Home for Christmas
overview: Jed, Elly May, Jethro, and Granny take their first plane flight home for Christmas to surprise cousin Pearl, who is busy cooking up a feast to try win Mr. Brewster’s heart.

title: No Place Like Home
overview: Back home for Christmas, Elly May bonds with her old animal friends, while Pearl plays the piano for the “new” movie in town to impress Mr. Brewster.

title: Jed Rescues Pearl
overview: Pearl’s efforts to snag Mr. Brewster seem doomed until he makes an overly theatrical public proposal.

title: Back to Californy
overview: Jed is confronted with too many cooks and not enough vittles when he invites Pearl and Jethrine to Beverly Hills.

title: Jed's Dilemma
overview: Trying to cool a feud between Granny and Pearl, Jed takes his family on a sightseeing tour of Beverly Hills.

title: Jed Saves Drysdale's Marriage
overview: Jed believes that the Drysdale’s marriage is threatened when he looks to cousin Pearl for a housekeeper while his wife is away.

title: Elly's Animals
overview: The police and Elly’s animals converge on the Clampett estate when Pearl starts giving yodeling lessons.

title: Jed Throws a Wingding
overview: Two of Cousin Pearl’s most ardent former suitors come to visit her in Beverly Hills.

title: Jed Plays Solomon
overview: Granny’s plan to stop Pearl’s yodeling backfires when the police she called find her illegal still.

title: Duke Steals a Wife
overview: Duke, Jed’s bloodhound, becomes matchmaker for his master and Mademoiselle Denise, a glamorous Frenchwoman who is accompanying a French poodle intended for the Drysdale’s dog.

title: Jed Buys the Freeway
overview: A confidence man tries to sell Jed the Hollywood Bowl, Griffith Park, and the Hollywood Freeway.

title: Jed Becomes a Banker
overview: Jed is made a bank vice president so he can compete in an interbank skeet shoot.

title: The Family Tree
overview: An authority on American history finds evidence that Jed’s ancestors preceded the Mayflower to America.

title: Jed Cuts the Family Tree
overview: Pearl wants the family to be in High Society now that their forebears were one of the first families to come to America. Will Jed’s family become famous worldwide?

title: Granny's Spring Tonic
overview: Miss Hathaway’s brilliant-but-frumpy bank protegee, Gloria, is really a sultry gold-digger with eyes for Jed’s $34 million, and Jed’s just had his annual dose of Granny’s spring tonic.

title: Jed Pays His Income Tax
overview: When an IRS agent gets chased away by Granny, Mr. Drysdale tell him the story of how the Clampetts came to be rich and move to Beverly Hills.

title: The Clampetts and the Dodgers
overview: Jed and Jethro play golf with a famous baseball coach who witnesses Jethro’s pitching arm and wants to sign him up.

title: Duke Becomes a Father
overview: Denise returns for the birth of her dog’s puppies, and to see Jed for some “courtin’ and sparkin’.” Mrs. Drysdale isn’t nearly so happy when she finds the puppies share more in common with Duke the bloodhound than Claude the poodle.

title: The Clampetts Entertain
overview: Jed arranges a party to cheer up Granny, but Mr. Drysdale fears that attending with his visiting boss will reveal that he’s been lying about their sophistication.

title: The Clampetts in Court
overview: A couple who ran into the Clampetts’ car fake injuries and sue the Clampetts to try to get rich.

title: The Clampetts Get Psychoanalyzed
overview: Jethro needs a health certificate to graduate from the 5th grade, but he ends up at a psychiatrist.

title: The Psychiatrist Gets Clampetted
overview: Jethro finally gets his bill of health from the psychiatrist he visited, but Doctor Twombly really wants to talk to Granny again about her mountain remedies.

title: Elly Becomes a Secretary
overview: When Miss Hathaway gets sick and Mr. Drysdale has to speak at a conference, Jed decides helps out by running the bank and having Elly be his secretary.

title: Jethro's Friend
overview: Jethro brings home a friend, Armstrong Dueser McHugh III, who is coddled by a chauffeur who treats him as frail. The Clampetts know better, and show him a good time, friendship, and family.
